title_working: She Whispers I Love You Every Morning, Thinking I Can't Hear
world_rule: Broken headphones, a secret he can never react to

lines.text: Every morning on the walk to school, the prettiest girl I know whispers that she loves me.
lines.say: (soft tone) Every morning on the walk to school, the prettiest girl I know whispers that she loves me.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She thinks I can't hear her, because of my big headphones.
lines.say: (nervous) She thinks I can't hear her, because of my big headphones.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: They broke two years ago. I only wear them so nobody talks to me.
lines.say: (sad) They broke two years ago. I only wear them so nobody talks to me.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Her name is Hana. The shyest girl in our whole school.
lines.say: (happy) Her name is Hana. The shyest girl in our whole school.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: On Monday, she looked straight ahead and whispered, I love you.
lines.say: (soft tone) On Monday, she looked straight ahead and whispered, I love you.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I kept my face perfectly still. Then I walked right into a pole.
lines.say: (happy) I kept my face perfectly still. Then I walked right into a pole.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: If she ever finds out I heard, she'll stop. So I can never react.
lines.say: (worried) If she ever finds out I heard, she'll stop. So I can never react.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: On Tuesday, she tapped my headphones and asked what I was listening to. I panicked. Rain sounds.
lines.say: (nervous) On Tuesday, she tapped my headphones and asked what I was listening to. I panicked. Rain sounds.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: On Wednesday, she knew thirty facts about rain. She stayed up all night, just to have something to tell me.
lines.say: (happy) On Wednesday, she knew thirty facts about rain. She stayed up all night, just to have something to tell me.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: During the fire drill, under the loud alarm, she held my hand and said I have nice eyelashes. I just nodded along to the rain.
lines.say: (happy) During the fire drill, under the loud alarm, she held my hand and said I have nice eyelashes. I just nodded along to the rain.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: On Thursday, she fell asleep on my shoulder on the bus and mumbled, one day you'll really hear me.
lines.say: (soft tone) On Thursday, she fell asleep on my shoulder on the bus and mumbled, one day you'll really hear me.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: On Friday, she whispered it again. So I took my headphones off and said, I love you too.
lines.say: (confident) On Friday, she whispered it again. So I took my headphones off and said, I love you too.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She froze. You heard everything? Even the eyelashes? She turned so red she hid her face in her sleeves.
lines.say: (happy) She froze. You heard everything? Even the eyelashes? She turned so red she hid her face in her sleeves.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then she laughed and ran across the road, shouting it so the whole street could hear.
lines.say: (happy) Then she laughed and ran across the road, shouting it so the whole street could hear.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: For the first time ever, she wasn't shy at all.
lines.say: (soft tone) For the first time ever, she wasn't shy at all.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: She never saw the truck.
lines.say: (sad) She never saw the truck.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Her stone has a little raindrop carved on it. That was my idea.
lines.say: (sad) Her stone has a little raindrop carved on it. That was my idea.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I still walk to school every morning in my broken headphones.
lines.say: (sad) I still walk to school every morning in my broken headphones.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: And every morning at the corner, I hear her. I love you.
lines.say: (soft tone) And every morning at the corner, I hear her. I love you.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I keep my face perfectly still. If she ever finds out I can hear her, she might stop.
lines.say: (soft tone) I keep my face perfectly still. If she ever finds out I can hear her, she might stop.
lines.speaker: narrator
